comparison.note: delta = random minus group_episode; a large positive delta indicates speaker leakage

split.name: random
split.leakage: speaker identity leaks between splits — scores are optimistic

splits.contamination: Production weights were trained on an unseeded random ~70% of every clip (Model/model_train.ipynb), so their test subset overlaps training data. Treat these numbers as optimistic and retrain with `python -m ml.train` for clean scores.
